title: Event Lifecycle Relations
description: Versioned lifecycle relations for institutional event records. Corrections, reversals and cancellations are explicit append-only links between retained records: a superseding record NEVER mutates or erases the record it references, and originals remain retained unconditionally. Promoted from the experimental extension after cross-repository validation against two synthetic institutions' pipelines (order-independent resolution, self-reference and cycle rejection, orphan links represented explicitly).

correction_sequence.description: Monotonic sequence of successive corrections to one original; informational.

reason_ref.description: Opaque reference to an externally held reason record; no content embedded.
